description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI class, a REST API endpoint implementing CRUD operations related to employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. It handles listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting individual immigration records associated with employee entities, including validation rules, API documentation annotations, and service integration.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing CRUD operations for employee immigration records, with detailed validation, Swagger documentation annotations, and interaction with the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles listing employee immigration records with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee immigration record based on request payload.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified immigration records for an employee.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a single immigration record for an employee by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee immigration record with provided data.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyImmigrations
methods.description: Helper method to create or update employee immigration record entities based on request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the list endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a record.
